1780 mm uniform connected gap / 50 Pa / viscosity 1.81×10⁻⁵ Pa·s; Q = b h³ Δp / (12 μ L).

This is a central-slot sensitivity, not measured leakage, an installed rating, a strict bound or a joint allowance.
Old backing 4058 would clash by 2 mm under the SAME challenge; neither nominal clearance nor overlap alone suffices.
No water head is assigned to this dry apron; quiet −35 / crest +15 do not establish first-leak or capillary performance.
Both floor routes owe the same complete opening. Air leakage alone does not justify a vacuum-style metal seal.
Actual supported overlap / replaceable compression interface, ends, movement and renewal must earn their result.
